description: This PHP source file defines the DummyPaymentMethod class, a mock payment method used for testing purposes within the Goteo project. It extends an abstract payment method class and provides methods for simulating payment gateway responses, including purchase, completion, refund, and response rendering.

classes.name: DummyPaymentMethod
classes.description: A mock payment method class for testing, which does not perform real transactions but simulates responses for testing purposes.

methods.name: getGatewayName
methods.description: Returns the name of the gateway, 'Dummy'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the payment method, 'Dummy Payment'.

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Provides a description indicating this is a test payment method.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the URL to the icon representing the payment method.

methods.name: getDefaultHttpResponse
methods.description: Generates a dummy HTML response simulating a payment gateway interface if in simulation mode.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Simulates a purchase process, sets the gateway to simulation mode, and returns a failed response.

methods.name: completePurchase
methods.description: Completes a purchase by creating a dummy payment request and sending it.

methods.name: refundable
methods.description: Indicates that the payment method supports refunds.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund, updates the investment amount, and dispatches an event.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Indicates that internal payments do not increase raised amounts.
